weights.provenance: spec 3.1 audited baseline; inverse_density is the declared ablation

certificate_tolerance_nats.provenance: per point-frame bound on log ell truncation error (estimator/svgd_k1_observation.py)

domain_tail_probability.provenance: certified domain {b_0 >= b_0 at chi2_6(1 - p)}; queries outside are counted, not hidden

rho.provenance: held-out spatial-block CV (spec 3.2); block edge = 8 x the frame KDE spacing; sensitivity reported per run

first_pass_kappa.provenance: two-level certified grid: rows with certificate > tolerance are recomputed on the full radius; null = single certified grid (measured: the first pass did not pay at tau = 1e-6)

integration.provenance: spec 3.3: one shared 6D latent anchor; error measured vs QMC oracle

qmc_nodes.provenance: scrambled Sobol nodes for points whose Laplace matrix is not SPD (64 nodes; accuracy measured against 8192-node QMC in tests)

a_eff.provenance: spec 3.3 formula with H_X = s_0^2 I, H_C = Lambda_C of frame 0 (point-cloud spacing / representation statistics); unit = sensitivity control

motion_prior.provenance: translation: repository noise file (velocity 1 m^2/s^2, q_c 0.01 m^2/s^3); rotation: declared 2 rad/s initial sd, 1 rad^2/s^3 random walk (NOT calibrated)

beta.provenance: uniform prior on the moving fraction pi (never set from GT)

svgd.provenance: Liu & Wang reference AdaGrad + median-heuristic RBF in whitened motion coordinates; M is NOT a number of parts

map.provenance: Adam on the SAME F in the same coordinates, started at the best final SVGD particle; two deterministic starts (best final SVGD particle, identity), same F; the higher F is reported

alpha.provenance: posterior expected FDR budget on UNCALIBRATED gamma (model-based statement only)
